policy: Editable source. Specification-derived tests (US-MSR-<section>-<seq> stories, generated fresh by tools/backlog/generate-jira-backlog.mjs on every run) always start not_run: nothing about a generated test's status is durable on its own. A status here counts only when it is passing, not_run, partial or blocked, the entry carries a reviewed summary and date, and (for passing) an automated test is titled with the exact TC ID and, in CI, actually passed in that run. Validated by tools/requirements/specification-test-status.mjs on every generation and, in CI, against the run's TAP reports.

statuses.summary: OIDC/OAuth2: createJwtCredentialVerifier (jose) verifies the bearer token's signature against the provider's published keys and createAuthenticator maps it to an interactive principal; a token not signed by the provider's key is refused. Demonstrated directly, not inferred from a broader test.

MFA: a session receives mfa assurance only when the token's amr claim carries mfa, and the provider policy's requireMfa refuses a single-factor (pwd-only) credential with authentication_assurance_insufficient. Demonstrated directly, not inferred from a broader test.
